notes: Complete Kül Tigin east-face D1 passage, 31 tokens. Source: https://tr.wikisource.org/wiki/Orhun_Yaz%C4%B1tlar%C4%B1_(K%C3%BCl_Tigin). The showcase source documents the Yenisei-to-Orkhon EZ substitution. Dividers are normalized to spaces. Capitals and line breaks are editorial. New Orkhon is speculative type design, not a recovered historical stage.

title: Serif / Sans
notes: Both specimens use the same Unicode, case ranges, baseline and em size.

title: Kül Tigin / text comparison

elements.text: NOTO SANS OLD TURKIC / DIGITAL REFERENCE

notes: Both rows use the same logical Unicode sequence. Noto Sans Old Turkic is a digital reference, not a facsimile of the inscription. New Orkhon adds an authored case distinction without changing the codepoints.

title: Letter construction

elements.text: Side bowl and overhanging top arm

notes: Reference outlines are from Noto Sans Old Turkic. New forms are authored design choices. AEN uses a single N; EM follows the selected R-like writing route without a left post; AT has a b-like stem/bowl and a left-overhanging top arm. No historical inevitability is claimed.

title: Capitals and lowercase
notes: Case is selected with ss01/ss02 or separate default fonts, not invented Unicode case points. In 0.13 capital EC uses Greek capital-Lambda construction. In 0.13 its curved lowercase body moved up exactly 190 units. The 0.14 revision refits the serifs to its legs. Both feet stop on the baseline.

title: Vertical metrics / blueprint 01
notes: Contours are from the compiled fonts. Vertical hairlines mark ink bounds, not advance widths. Round forms may overshoot by 10 units. EC lowercase is an ascender-height exception: its head is at 700 and its feet at 0.

title: Serif stroke weights / blueprint 02
notes: Measurements are from compiled contours: I at y=350 and A at x=250. 90/64 are ordinary Serif construction widths. Curved and diagonal sections have optical exceptions.

title: Sans stroke weights / blueprint 03
notes: Measurements are from compiled contours: I at y=350 and A at x=250. 84/76 are ordinary Sans construction widths. Curved and diagonal sections have optical exceptions.

title: AL kerning / blueprint 04

elements.text: The left neighbor can move over the hook when its underside is clear.

notes: Logical AL + AY is physically AY to the left of AL because the script is RTL. 73 safe case-specific neighbors are enabled in 0.13. The newly raised lowercase EC now also qualifies. Compiled clearance across all enabled pairs is at least 38.5 units. No standalone shape is changed by kerning.

title: EM + I / blueprint 05

elements.text: The text remains two Unicode characters.

notes: Standard liga substitutes matching capital or lowercase pairs. Mixed cases remain separate. Source text stays U+10C22 U+10C03. The slide artwork is converted to vector paths, not live copyable text.

title: Alphabet / 1
notes: Alphabet page 1 of 2. Every encoded Orkhon sign in formal Unicode order, with capital on the left and lowercase on the right. Case forms are alternate glyphs under the same Unicode characters.

title: Alphabet / 2
notes: Alphabet page 2 of 2. Every encoded Orkhon sign in formal Unicode order, with capital on the left and lowercase on the right. Case forms are alternate glyphs under the same Unicode characters.

title: New Orkhon / 0.16.2
notes: New Orkhon 0.16.2. Four installable TTFs with ss01/ss02, kern and liga. Teŋri is from Kül Tigin D1 with editorial case. Typeface licensed under OFL 1.1. The supplied PowerPoint uses native editable vector glyphs and editable Latin text.
